description: Native retirement inventory: what desktop/ and the desktop workflows contain, what still reads them, and each item's disposition (retire / re-home as a shared browser check / keep as history). Produced with the release scan from scripts/inventory/native-releases.mjs.

source.read_note: desktop/ tree and workflows read at exactly 6107f80 (GitHub API, byte-equivalent to git show). No desktop/ file changed between 6107f80 and a42829b.

release_scan.method: scripts/inventory/native-releases.mjs (GitHub REST API; rerun in CI with JSON output attached)
release_scan.consequence: No release assets exist to preserve; no release text exists to mark historical; no installed client can be redirected because no update feed was ever served.

shared_browser_dependencies.purpose: createDesktopRuntime(): Tauri IPC adapter (native_start/cancel/release, native-event, native_read_artifact) behind the same engine interface; CPU-only; selected when globalThis.__TAURI__ (src/Next/product-bridge.mjs:6)
shared_browser_dependencies.note: Imported browser code, not packaging: re-home into the app tree (import allowlist row) and keep the build-id hash input stable or deliberately changed with a documented reason.

shared_browser_dependencies.purpose: Verifies downloaded web artifact bytes against a revision; writes a receipt JSON
consumers: not called by next-matrix.yml or next-gpu-lane.yml
shared_browser_dependencies.note: Shared browser/E2E check: re-home with the browser/E2E workflows that call it (ws-verify).

items.purpose: Tauri 2 shell: commands, one-job supervisor, updater plugin registration (empty config), native-probe CLI
items.note: Native packages are retired; licence/provenance texts inside (desktop/native/ALIGNMENT-LICENSE, licenses/NVIDIA-LICENSE.txt, PROVENANCE.md) stay in Git history.

items.path: desktop/native/ (alignment.py, asset_store.py, bundle_paths.py, prepare_bundle.py, product_worker.py, worker.py, requirements*.txt)
items.purpose: Native CPU supervisor/worker: ORT inference, dlib alignment, e4e encoding, synthesis; bundle verification with 31 reference cases
items.note: Research heritage: worker.py's 31-case diagnostic informed browser qualification; history preserves it.

items.path: desktop/scripts/ (prepare-release.mjs, build-native-runtime.py, build-dlib-arm64.py, candidate-artifacts.py, fetch-native-bundle.py, prepare-ci-bundle.py, acquire-product-manifest.py, verify-source.py, stage-frontend.mjs, stage-native-notices.py)
